name: Sales CRM
description: A Pipedrive-style sales CRM: a drag-and-drop pipeline board with a per-stage value funnel, a leads inbox worked as a split view and fed by lead forms the team builds (published on the website or filed by hand), deals with activities, documentation, products and files, contacts and organizations, and an insights dashboard. Hand-authored reference app — the best Pipedrive clone expressible against today's runtime, with everything it cannot do recorded in CRM-GAPS.md.

archetype.coreJob: Move deals through the pipeline stages on a board and never miss the next activity on any open deal

uses.why: a deal owns one documentation space; its pages replace the old note feed

entities.label: Deal
entities.description: An opportunity moving through the pipeline. Stage (where it is in the funnel) is independent of status (open/won/lost), exactly like Pipedrive.

fields.label: Stage
fields.help: Where the deal sits in the pipeline. Drag the card on the Pipeline board to change it.

fields.label: Status
fields.help: Open deals live on the board; Won/Lost is decided with the header buttons, independent of stage.

fields.label: Probability %
fields.help: Kept in sync with the stage by workflows; set to 100/0 on win/loss.

fields.label: Weighted value
fields.help: Deal value x win probability - the honest forecast number.

fields.label: Next step
fields.help: The next concrete action that moves this deal.

fields.label: Follow up on
fields.help: When the next step is due — drives My Day.

fields.label: Documentation
fields.help: The Documents space this deal owns. Filled by the Documentation tab on first use.

entities.label: Activity
entities.description: A call, meeting, task or email that HAPPENED — the historic log of touches on a deal, person and organization. Planning the next move lives on the deal (next step + follow up on), not here.

fields.label: Date
fields.help: When it happened.

entities.label: Lead
entities.description: An unqualified inbound/outbound prospect. Qualify it in the Leads inbox and convert it into a deal.

fields.label: Received
fields.help: When this lead came in — sorts the inbox and the leads list.

fields.label: Company (as given)
fields.help: What the enquiry called itself. Kept as typed: a lead arrives before anybody has decided it is worth a record, and the raw wording is evidence of where it came from.

fields.label: Organization
fields.help: The company record this lead was matched to. Optional on purpose - an unqualified enquiry has no organization yet, and forcing one would mean creating a company record for every scrap of inbound interest. Fill it in and the lead shows up on that company's page.

fields.label: Owner
fields.help: The rep working this lead. A lead a form files starts with the owner the form names, one typed in by hand starts with whoever typed it, and either can be handed on at any time.

fields.label: Filed from
fields.help: The form submission this lead was filed from. Empty for a lead somebody typed in. What they answered is shown on the lead, question by question.

fields.label: Amount
fields.help: Line total. Enter quantity × unit price — the runtime has no computed fields yet.

entities.label: Lead form
entities.description: A form the team builds to capture leads: published on the website through its own link, used on a stand at an event, or filed by hand when somebody phones. Its questions are its own records, and what it FILES is declared here: a lead, starting with the owner and source the form names.

fields.label: Intro text
fields.help: Shown above the questions, on the public page too.

fields.label: Active
fields.help: Retired forms stay in the list for their submissions but are not offered.

fields.label: Creates
fields.help: The entity a submission files. Picked in the form designer, not typed.

fields.label: Owner
fields.help: Every lead from this form starts owned by this rep. Leave it empty and its leads wait in the inbox for somebody to take them.

fields.label: Source
fields.help: Where every lead from this form says it came from: Website for the form on your site, Event for the one used on a stand.

fields.label: Confirm the address
fields.help: Almost every form should accept straight away. Ask for confirmation only where a wrong address would put real work in somebody's queue.

fields.label: Published
fields.help: Off, the link is dead. On, anyone holding the address can fill this form in and nothing else.

fields.label: Public link
fields.help: Generated, never typed. This is the address itself, which is why it is long and unguessable.

blocks.label: Every lead from it starts with

entities.label: Question
entities.description: One question on one lead form, and which field of the filed lead its answer fills.

fields.label: Choices
fields.help: The options a choice question offers. Empty for every other kind.

fields.label: Must be answered
fields.help: Enforced on the server. Without this role it would be a courtesy the browser pays and a stranger can skip.

fields.label: This asks for the submitter's own email
fields.help: Marks WHICH question holds the address a confirmation link goes to. A form can ask for several addresses and only the author knows which one is theirs.

fields.label: Fills
fields.help: Which field of the filed lead this answer lands in. Empty means the answer is kept on the submission only.

entities.label: Submission
entities.description: One filled-in lead form. The durable artifact: the answers are kept whether or not a lead was ever filed from them.

entities.label: Answer
entities.description: One answer to one question of one submission.

pages.label: My Day
pages.subtitle: Your open deals and the follow-ups due today.

pages.label: Activities
pages.subtitle: Everything the team has logged against its deals.

pages.label: Insights
pages.subtitle: How the pipeline is doing and what it is likely to bring in.

columns.label: Pipeline funnel — open value by stage

commands.label: Convert to deal

confirm.title: Convert this lead into a deal?
confirm.message: A new deal is created in Lead In with this lead's title, value and owner. Link the organization and contact person on the deal afterwards.

commands.successMessage: Lead converted — the new deal is in the pipeline at Lead In.

workflows.name: A lead typed in by hand starts with whoever typed it

roles.name: Sales Rep
roles.description: Works leads, deals and activities, and files a lead through a form when somebody phones. Cannot delete records, manage the product catalog or change the forms.

roles.name: Sales Manager
roles.description: Everything a rep can do, plus deletes, the product catalog and the lead forms, including publishing one on the website.
